models.note: Owner-supplied model, slimmed from recliner-lazboy.glb (746k to 80k triangles, normals recomputed on load). models.name: natural rattan daybed with rust-red bedding and patterned pillows
models.note: Owner-supplied model, slimmed from daybed.glb (1.1M to 150k triangles, texture seams locked so the bedding texture stays clean, full 2048 texture kept); true to scale in metres (75" L x 38" D x 35" H). Back against the east wall, per the owner's layout.

models.name: Compton sofa
models.note: Owner-supplied model. No product size was given: scaled to a typical low, deep sofa, 96" wide (about 64" deep, 27" tall). In the lower-level sitting room, centred on the 100" projector screen on the west wall and facing it, about 11 ft back. Stretched 20% taller ("stretch": y 1.2) at the owner's request.

models.name: Crate & Barrel Drift sectional, Moss
models.note: Owner-supplied model (drift-moss.glb, 374k triangles, 11.1 MB), slimmed with gltfpack -si 0.22 to drift-moss.opt.glb (82k triangles, 2.3 MB, textures kept). Not to scale: scaled to the Crate & Barrel Drift pieces' 29.5" height, which gives 125" x 92", about a three-piece L of Drift pieces (wedge, armless and arm chairs, 129" x 95"). Stands in for both halves of the old sectional: corner in the north-east, long side along the east wall, short side under the rear windows.
